name: All Mail Buddy for Proton
summary: I Proton Mail Bridge: yesskan akaram d tebzert tilawin n yal tabrat deg All Mail yerna yessebded kkes, smimeḍ, eǧǧ ɣer tazarkt, d spam ad xedmen ɣef tebrat deg ukaram-is ilawin.
description:
Proton Mail Bridge yesskan akk tibratin deg ukaram All Mail, maca dihin ur tezmireḍ ara ad twaliḍ anda i d-tella tebrat s tidet, yerna tukksa neɣ asmimeḍ ur xeddmen ara ayen i tettamnaḍ. All Mail Buddy yesseɣli-t. Timahilin
  • Akaram ilawin s tmuɣli kan: tijadwal Folder d Labels deg tmuɣli n tfelwit, tafaṭṭ deg yal takarḍa deg tmuɣli n tkarḍiwin.
  • Tigawt ɣef tebrat tilawit: Kkes, Shift+Delete, Smimeḍ, Nɣel, Ɣer tazarkt, Spam, Mačči d spam, ger-d sers d tqeffalin n waddur ttxeddmen ɣef tebrat deg ukaram-is ilawin, mačči ɣef tmuɣli-ines n All Mail.
  • Aɣelsan seg usdukkel: tebrat tettwaxdem kan ma yella yiwen n unɣal ilawan yemṣada. Send tukksa i d-yettaǧǧan, asemmil yesnaqad deg uqeddac belli anɣal mazal d tabrat tameɣtut.
  • Tibratin war akaram: yufa tibratin i yellan kan deg All Mail yerna yeǧǧa-k ad tsekkiḍ, ad tesrekkseḍ neɣ ad tekkseḍ-tent, daɣen akk-d yiwen n unadi yettwaklasen.
  • Yettqim yemtawa: asenqed afessas yal kra n tesdidin yufa ibeddlen i yexdem deg yisnasen n Proton-nniḍen yerna yemtawa kan ikaramen i yettubeddlen.
  • Asekyed: asebter n yiɣewwaren yessefhem yal ugur s wawalen igerzen yerna yettak asewway n yikaramen i yettwaḥuzen kan.
Ikaramen akk d yimiḍanen-nniḍen ad ɣren tikli tamagnut n Thunderbird. Asemmil yettmeslay kan d Bridge-ik adigan, s tuqqna IMAP n Thunderbird. Yessewham Thunderbird 153 neɣ wayen i d-iteddun d Proton Mail Bridge. War assaɣ ɣer Proton AG.
